The excalidraw file is the source of truth, just pop it into https://excalidraw.com/ if you want to update.

This is current as of 8/6/2025. Changes are planned / coming to the session service and #agent-session-experience team is investing evolving the service in the long term, so if this gets too far out of date we should delete it and/or refresh it.
